name: gmail-wiki-ingest
description: Triage a batch of the user's email against their personal knowledge wiki and hand the verdicts back to javis-server, which bands them into auto-ingest / review card / auto-discard. Runs daily on an in-container openclaw cron agent turn, and on demand. Two script commands (fetch / submit) call javis-server with the container's gateway token; bodies never leave the server, and bands, sender trust and every write stay server-side. Triggers: 'ingest my email', 'gmail ingest', '整理邮件', '邮件入库'.
